neighbours.label: a word naming the material a crafted or manufactured object is made of (glass, acrylic, cotton, vellum, nylon) in product or craft descriptions; the same objects described without a material stay low
fire: The jewelry box has a hinged lid of frosted glass and brass corners.
Each tote bag is sewn from heavy canvas with leather handles.
The display case is built from clear plexiglass on a walnut base.
I backed the card with a sheet of shimmering acetate.
This scarf is knitted from fine merino wool in three colours.
The bottle stopper is carved from solid cork and sealed with wax.
Her new raincoat is made of waxed linen that sheds water.
The lantern panels are cut from thin sheets of mica.
